title: Lurene Haines
description: "I am confident that in the STAR WARS future there are mechanics, pilots and soldiers that are women," asserts Lurene Haines. "Hence the female rebel riding her tauntaun." Haines has been a successful illustrator for seven years. She enjoys working in diversified styles and mediums, and is recognized for her pencil, color pencil, oil, and watercolor renderings. Noteworthy projects include HELLRAISER, GREEN ARROW: THE LONGBOW HUNTERS, MISS FURY, DEEP SPACE NINE and a 32 page book of her pin-up art, FEMINA: DREAM GIRLS. She is currently working on a fully painted 6-issue comics series based on the CAT PEOPLE.
